free_tier.stated: '免费试用额度仅对完成中国大陆实名认证的账号开放，未完成认证的账号无法触发额度发放逻辑' — the free trial quota is issued only to accounts that have completed mainland-China real-name verification; an unverified account never triggers the issuance. The article's stated precondition is '已完成中国大陆手机号+身份证双重实名认证的火山引擎账号' — a mainland mobile number plus a national identity card.

per_object_cap.stated: one free trial quota per account, gated on real-name verification status rather than on quantity

retention.stated: Not stated on the article read: the trial quota's validity period and the instance lifetime are not given in the troubleshooting guide. The article names the trial as time-limited ('限时赠送') without a duration.

egress.terms: not published on the page read

interface_detail: Volcengine ECS instances with SSH and a console; the trial page read is about the quota rather than the machine
tooling: any SSH client; the vendor console
chaining: Out of reach: the gate is a mainland national identity card, which no amount of card or phone solves.

limits.value: mainland-China real-name verification: a mainland mobile number plus a national identity card
accounts verified outside mainland China are told to apply for regional trial entitlements instead
the trial quota lapses automatically once a paid plan is opened on the account

binding_note: The national ID is the first and only thing that matters: without a mainland identity card the quota logic is never triggered at all.

identity_cost.detail: national ID required: a mainland-China mobile number plus an identity card (身份证), verified as 实名认证. No card is mentioned as the gate on the page read; the gate is the identity document and the mainland phone number behind it.

confidence_note: The real-name requirement and the phone-plus-ID pair are quoted from Volcengine's own developer article read. A second Volcengine documentation page on real-name verification returned a DNS failure, so the official verification page itself was not read.
